verdict.rationale: Warp documents that cloud agents can run on 'Warp's cloud infrastructure or your own' via self-hosted workers authenticated with API keys, and the client source is open under AGPL v3 so it can be audited and built. Nothing shows that the backend services behind accounts, Warp Drive, the Admin Panel and model routing can be self-hosted, so only the agent execution layer and the client are under user control. missing for 10: a self-hostable backend/control plane, documented self-hosting deployment guides, independent corroboration of self-hosted worker setups.
